newsitem.title: CHINA: China chemical industry grows 11 pct in Jan-Nov.
newsitem.headline: China chemical industry grows 11 pct in Jan-Nov.

text.p: China's chemical industry generated more than 22 billion yuan in output value in November, an increase of more than 11 percent compared with the year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said.
Total output for the sector in the first 11 months of the year reached nearly 232 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of about 11 percent, it said.

Except for fine methanol and glacial acetic acid, output of the sector's 14 other major products rose, with output growth of synthetic ammonia, thick nitric acid, sodium carbonate, pesticides and paint each growing by more than 10 percent, it said.

In November, China produced more than two million tonnes of chemical fertilisers, falling 2.0 percent compared with October but up by 4.3 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said. It gave no more details.
